THE CAPSTONE.note: The brochure is headed with the developer's own name and never prints the project's. Registered as THE BEAUMONDE, which shares no word with 'THE CAPSTONE', so no name search can reach it; its registered promoter is THE CAPSTONE DEVELOPERS. Recorded by hand because the script only finds it via the uploaded filename, which a re-upload could lose.

Vaikunth.note: User confirmed against the printed reg no on the physical brochure. This is the Bopal candidate the script already surfaced (entityId 20094), not the Ambli one (19481) — its registered promoter SHILAJ INFRABUILD LLP is presumably the brochure developer 'A.Shridhar Group' operating through an SPV, which the script cannot verify by name alone.

SHANTIGRAM.note: OCR extracted the township location as the project name — the brochure's actual filename is 'Adani Belrosa Brochure.pdf'. Registered as BELROSA, sharing no word with 'SHANTIGRAM' (which is the address, not the project — 'Shantigram, Nr. Vaishnodevi Circle, S.G. Highway'), so unreachable by any name search. Not to be confused with the separately-matched 'Shaligram Luxuria' (RAA10653), a different project entirely.
